test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The little boy asked his teacher if she had always been good as a child.

options.text: The little boy said to his teacher, “You have always been good as a child?”
The little boy said to his teacher, “Are you always good as a child?”
The little boy said to his teacher, “Ma’am, always you were good as a child?”
The little boy said to his teacher, “Ma’am, were you always good as a child?”

solution:
The correct answer is **The little boy said to his teacher, “Ma’am, were you always good as a child?”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question we have to change it into Direct Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• 'Asked' will be changed into **'said to'** because the given question is an example of an interrogative sentence with a question word. 
 
• Comma and inverted commas will be added.
 
• **'had been'** will be changed into '**were**' because the **pronoun** '**she**' will be changed into '**you**' and the **pronoun **'**you**' is always followed by **a plural helping verb.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Answer:__** *The little boy said to his teacher, “Ma’am, were you always good as a child?”*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य **Indirect Speech** में है। प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे **Direct Speech** में बदलना होगा।
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• '**Asked**' को **'said to' **में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि दिया गया प्रश्न प्रश्नवाचक शब्द के साथ एक प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य का उदाहरण है।
 
• अल्पविराम और उल्टे अल्पविराम जोड़े जाएंगे।
 
• **'had been' **को '**were**' में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि **pronoun** '**she**' को '**you**' में बदल दिया जाएगा और **pronoun** '**you**' हमेशा एक **plural helping verb **के बाद होता है।
 
 
 
• अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 4** है। 

107:T1052,

​The correct answer is **'****She said that it was her birthday the following week'.**
